create_ImageList_from_tensors: create an ImageList from a list of torch tensors with optional size divisibility padding
build_ImageList_batched_tensor: build a batched tensor from images of varying sizes padded to the same dimensions
access_ImageList_getitem: access an individual image from an ImageList by index in its original unpadded size
move_ImageList_to_device: move an ImageList tensor to a different device like cuda or cpu
inspect_ImageList_device_property: inspect the device property of an ImageList to check which GPU or CPU it resides on
